signal: HSI released a platform-wide AI assistant unifying EHS, training and regulatory knowledge, and partnered with Enhesa for a new Regulatory and Compliance Module

email.body1:
Nancy, saw HSI release the platform-wide AI assistant and partner with Enhesa on the compliance module.

New capabilities open conversations across your whole customer and prospect base, usually more accounts in-market than the inside team can cover at once. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for HSI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Nancy, quick follow-up for HSI.

New AI and compliance features spike interest, but most teams can't tell how many of those accounts they're actually touching, so it converts at a fraction of its potential. The gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your inside team needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Nancy, last bit of proof for HSI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how HSI's reply rate likely compares to peer EHS and training-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nancy, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Rolling out new AI and compliance features is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an EHS-software motion? I'll tailor it to HSI either way.
